2025 Vintage Release

Van Loggerenberg is the label of Lukas (Young Winemaker of the Year 2018) and Roxanne van Loggerenberg, working with old — and not-so-old — vineyards across the Paardeberg, Piekenierskloof, Polkadraai Hills, Stellenbosch, Franschhoek and Swartland, telling each site's story through wine.

2025 marks their tenth vintage under their own label, and Lukas rates it among the best harvests of his career. A cold winter and mild growing season meant no rush to pick — each vineyard was harvested only once it reached its natural balance, resulting in wines of remarkable purity, precision and composure. This is a vintage worth going deep on.
